sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Sundering Dual Axes (裂空双斧) is a dual-wielded blade pair in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. Heartpiercer's axes. Slow, wide, and the reason the Three Wardens Fall trophy can be finished without a second build.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Sundering Dual Axes (裂空双斧) occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as Dual-wield. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not publish a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons, and no measurement of this one has been recorded, so no damage, scaling or speed figure is given here. A number invented from how the weapon looks is exactly the kind of filler this page exists to avoid.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. No verified note on how this weapon behaves inside a combo has been published, so nothing is written here.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Meigu Lake, White Serpent House - defeat Heartpiercer.

Dropped by Heartpiercer - see that page for the fight itself, and boss drops for the reverse list.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.
